purpose: Source-grounded geoid model registry and acceptance gates. This metadata is not a grid, a height-transformation implementation, or scientific validation.

models.notes: Do not infer the tide system, realization, or suitability of a dataset from the model name alone.

models.status: NGA latest published model at review date; NGA page indicates a possible new model in 2028
models.notes: Never silently substitute EGM2008 for a dataset explicitly declared as EGM96.

reference_dataset.title: GeoidHeights.dat.gz
reference_dataset.oracle_description: GeographicLib documentation attributes the values to NGA harmonic-synthesis programs.
limitations: Not field-survey truth and not independent of NGA model coefficients or conventions.
Not by itself a validation of grid interpolation or vertical coordinate-operation direction.
Artifact has not been downloaded, locally hash-verified, sampled, or run in GEOLOGIA CI.

acceptance_gates: Pin a traceable grid artifact and verify its exact SHA-256 before parsing.
Use documented reference values and state whether the oracle is independent software, an authoritative model, or field survey.
Test grid nodes and interior interpolation separately, including axis order, longitude wrap, boundaries, outside coverage, nodata, and missing grid.
Validate the selected operation's sign convention and CRS metadata; do not generalize h = H + N to unrelated vertical datums without checking their operation definition.
Reject unavailable or out-of-area operations; never silently fall back to another geoid model.
Report operation, grid, uncertainty, and provenance alongside any future transformed heights.
